title: Affine moment
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type, let $r,c,t\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Define the affine moment as the expectation over $x\in\Omega$ of $(1+ctX(x))^r$.
